name: Do I need to hire a separate plumber and electrician for my kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate plumber and electrician for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, when you work with a general contractor for a kitchen remodel, you do not need to hire separate plumbers or electricians. As a full-service contractor, we manage all necessary trades, including licensed plumbers and electricians, who are part of our team or trusted subcontractors. This ensures a seamless project, proper coordination, and compliance with local building codes. We handle all scheduling and oversight so you have a single point of contact for the entire project, simplifying the remodeling experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, a general contractor typically manages all necessary trades like plumbers and electricians, providing a single point of contact for your remodel.
